name: The Glowing Fruit
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.

Denalan would want to study this fruit, you are certain.
narrative.objectives: Bring the glowing fruit to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You found this on Teldrassil? Intriguing... this fruit is exotic. Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off. Perhaps even as far as Azeroth! And there's something about this fruit... it seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of Teldrassil.

Thank you, adventurer. Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, you look like you have something to tell me. Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
